name: Article to trial nct_id equality join, unanchored
cypher: MATCH (a:Article) WHERE a.nct_id IS NOT NULL MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial) WHERE t.nct_id = a.nct_id RETURN count(DISTINCT a) AS linked_articles

name: Article to trial nct_id equality join, one side anchored
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial {nct_id:'NCT00000102'}) MATCH (a:Article) WHERE a.nct_id = t.nct_id RETURN a.pmid LIMIT 10

name: Gene to target symbol equality join, anchored
cypher: MATCH (g:Gene {symbol:'TP53'}) MATCH (t:Target) WHERE t.symbol = g.symbol RETURN DISTINCT t.symbol, t.ensembl_id LIMIT 10

name: Variant and target converge on one disease, half anchored
cypher: MATCH (v:Variant)-[:ASSOCIATED_WITH_DISEASE]->(d1:Disease) MATCH (t:Target {symbol:'EGFR'})-[:ASSOCIATED_WITH_DISEASE]->(d2:Disease) WHERE d1.mondo_id = d2.mondo_id RETURN DISTINCT v.rs_id, d1.name LIMIT 20

name: Pathway proteins to ChEMBL targets by accession
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(pw:Pathway {name:'Immune System'}) MATCH (ct:ChemblTarget) WHERE ct.uniprot_accession = p.uniprot_id RETURN DISTINCT ct.pref_name LIMIT 20

name: Trial sites in a surveillance country by name join
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {name:'India'}) MATCH (s:Site) WHERE s.country = c.name RETURN count(DISTINCT s) AS sites

name: Distinct articles annotated with Humans
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(m:MeSHTerm {name:'Humans'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT a) AS articles

name: Two distinct counts in one projection
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:VISITED]->(v:Visit) RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS patients, count(DISTINCT v.encounter_class) AS visit_classes

name: Distinct trial condition names
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:STUDIES]->(c:Condition) RETURN count(DISTINCT c.name) AS distinct_conditions

name: Distinct authors per journal, ordered by the aggregate alias
cypher: MATCH (j:Journal)<-[:PUBLISHED_IN]-(a:Article)-[:AUTHORED_BY]->(au:Author) RETURN j.title AS journal, count(DISTINCT au) AS authors ORDER BY authors DESC LIMIT 10

name: Article with optional MeSH and optional chemical
cypher: MATCH (a:Article {pmid:'1000000'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(m:MeSHTerm) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:MENTIONS_CHEMICAL]->(ch:Chemical) RETURN a.pmid, m.name, ch.name LIMIT 50

name: Trial with optional adverse events and outcomes
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial {nct_id:'NCT00000102'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:REPORTED]->(ae:AdverseEvent) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:MEASURES]->(o:Outcome) RETURN t.nct_id, count(DISTINCT ae) AS adverse_events, count(DISTINCT o) AS outcomes

name: Optional grant for machine-learning articles (nulls expected)
cypher: MATCH (m:MeSHTerm {name:'Machine Learning'})<-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]-(a:Article) WITH a LIMIT 200 OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:FUNDED_BY]->(g:Grant) RETURN a.pmid, g.agency LIMIT 500

name: Protein with optional pathway and optional GO term
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein {uniprot_id:'P04637'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(pw:Pathway) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(go:GOTerm) RETURN p.uniprot_id, pw.name, go.go_id LIMIT 100

name: Citation closure to depth 3 from one article
cypher: MATCH (a:Article {pmid:'1000000'})-[:CITES*1..3]->(b:Article) RETURN count(DISTINCT b) AS reachable_articles

name: Second-shell interaction partners of TP53
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein {uniprot_id:'P04637'})-[:INTERACTS_WITH*2..2]-(q:Protein) RETURN count(DISTINCT q) AS second_shell_partners

name: GO descendants of biological_process to depth 3
cypher: MATCH (root:GOTerm {go_id:'GO:0008150'})<-[:IS_A*1..3]-(d:GOTerm) RETURN count(DISTINCT d) AS descendants

name: Disease ontology ancestors, variable length, grouped
cypher: MATCH (d:Disease)-[:IS_A*1..3]->(anc:Disease) RETURN anc.name AS ancestor, count(DISTINCT d) AS descendants ORDER BY descendants DESC LIMIT 10

name: Articles per MeSH term under a prefix filter
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(m:MeSHTerm) WHERE m.name STARTS WITH 'Neoplasm' RETURN m.name AS mesh_term, count(a) AS articles ORDER BY articles DESC LIMIT 10

name: Articles per journal under a substring filter
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:PUBLISHED_IN]->(j:Journal) WHERE j.title CONTAINS 'Lancet' RETURN j.title AS journal, count(a) AS articles ORDER BY articles DESC LIMIT 10

name: Articles per chemical under a prefix filter
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:MENTIONS_CHEMICAL]->(c:Chemical) WHERE c.name STARTS WITH 'Insulin' RETURN c.name AS chemical, count(a) AS articles ORDER BY articles DESC LIMIT 10

name: Undirected citation neighbourhood of one article
cypher: MATCH (a:Article {pmid:'1000000'})-[:CITES]-(b:Article) RETURN count(DISTINCT b) AS citation_neighbours

name: Undirected interaction degree of BRCA1
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:INTERACTS_WITH]-(q:Protein) WHERE p.uniprot_id = 'P38398' RETURN count(DISTINCT q) AS partners

name: Co-authors of the most prolific author, undirected
cypher: MATCH (au:Author {name:'Wei Wang'})-[:AUTHORED_BY]-(a:Article)-[:AUTHORED_BY]-(au2:Author) WHERE au2.name <> 'Wei Wang' RETURN au2.name AS coauthor, count(DISTINCT a) AS papers ORDER BY papers DESC LIMIT 10
